title: Forward a terminal's request as the switch, and answer it as the terminal's

cases.says: an approved purchase reaches the network under the switch's terminal and acquirer IDs, without field 48, and the terminal gets the approval with its approval code
an approved balance inquiry gives the terminal the balance the network returned
a decline and a silent network are answered with the terminal's own STAN and terminal ID, because the request the answers start from was never renumbered
the approval is built from the terminal's request, so the network's private field and the switch's acquirer ID never reach the terminal
each network link has its own STAN sequence, unaffected by traffic on the other link
two terminals that use the same STAN at once are both answered, because the switch numbers what it sends

origin.section: 16.1 The Destination Gets a Copy Numbered by the Switch, and Every Answer Starts From the Source's Request
